issue.body:
Machine: Windows 10 x64 1703
Locale: en-US
Visual Studio 2017 Professional
Example Code: https://gist.github.com/henriquegemignani/ca8266a5c6def4ec4fc03e689646bfb8

Installed packages:
`vcpkg install curl:x64-windows zlib:x64-windows`

Instructions:
```
mkdir build
cd build
cmake -G "Visual Studio 15 2017 Win64" -T host=x64 -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=..\vcpkg\scripts\buildsystems\vcpkg.cmake -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET:STRING=x64-windows ..
cmake --build . --target curltest --config RelWithDebInfo
RelWithDebInfo\curltest.exe
```

Expcted:
Generated binary to run succesfully.

Actual:
`libcurl-d.dll` not found.

body: I've basically given up on trying to use the config for curl in vcpkg, instead we just look for the libs manually and we force a debug prefix so we can associate the libs properly per config. On windows I noticed the uppercase use of CURL breaks it too, lower case works even though the usage says otherwise.

Hi Everyone, thanks for reporting this issue!
It seems to have fixed a near version. So I closed it.
Thx.
